result.instructions: Tools for Mixpanel, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mixpanel data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run mixpanel_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mixpanel_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mixpanel_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. mixpanel_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mixpanel_top_events
tools.title: Top events (today)
tools.description: List today's top events with counts and % change vs yesterday. Good first call to discover what events a project tracks. Query API: GET /events/top.

type.description: general (totals), unique (per-user), or average. Default general.

tools.name: mixpanel_segmentation
tools.title: Segment an event
tools.description: Count/segment/filter a single event over a date range. e.g. 'Signed up' by country last week. Params `on`/`where` use Mixpanel segmentation expressions like properties["$country_code"]. Query API: GET /segmentation. (Upstream maintenance mode — for saved reports prefer mixpanel_query_insights.)

event.description: Single event name to analyze (not an array).

on.description: Property expression to segment on, e.g. properties["$city"].

limit.description: Top N property values (only if `on` set). Default 60.

tools.name: mixpanel_retention
tools.title: Retention report
tools.description: Cohort retention: of users who did `born_event`, how many came back and did `event` over subsequent intervals. Query API: GET /retention.

born_event.description: The defining first event for a birth cohort. Required when retention_type=birth.

event.description: Returning event to measure. If omitted, any event counts.

where.description: Filter expression applied to the returning event.

interval.description: Units per bucket (<=90 if days). Default 1.

tools.name: mixpanel_list_funnels
tools.title: List saved funnels
tools.description: Get the funnel_id and name of every saved funnel in the project. Query API: GET /funnels/list.

tools.name: mixpanel_query_funnel
tools.title: Query a saved funnel
tools.description: Get conversion data for a saved funnel (use mixpanel_list_funnels to find funnel_id). Query API: GET /funnels.

tools.name: mixpanel_query_insights
tools.title: Query a saved Insights report
tools.description: Fetch the computed data behind a saved Insights report by bookmark_id (the report id in the board URL). Mixpanel's recommended, non-deprecated path for programmatic reporting. Query API: GET /insights.

bookmark_id.description: Insights report id (bookmark_id) from the report URL.

tools.name: mixpanel_jql
tools.title: Run a JQL query
tools.description: Run a custom JQL (JavaScript Query Language) script for arbitrary analysis. Power-user escape hatch. Script must define main(). Query API: POST /jql. (Upstream maintenance mode; 2-min timeout, 5GB/query limit.)

script.description: JQL script defining function main(){ ... } that returns rows.

params.description: Optional JSON string exposed to the script as the `params` global.
